2.5.1.changelog:
[English](#en-v2.5.1) | [中文](#cn-v2.5.1)

New Features

* Models: Added support for connecting external vLLM instances and monitoring them in Overview by @ssongliu in https://github.com/1Panel-dev/1Panel/pull/14402 ### Enhancements * Models: Improved GPU group card layouts and topology-based ordering by @ssongliu in https://github.com/1Panel-dev/1Panel/pull/14404 * Models: Improved the vLLM deployment list and made image pulling opt-in by @ssongliu ### Bug Fixes * Models: Fixed issues with vLLM custom image synchronization and default image resets when switching versions by @ssongliu in https://github.com/1Panel-dev/1Panel/pull/14406 * Models: Fixed incorrect version matching for GB10 dual-node vLLM deployments and upgrades by @ssongliu in https://github.com/1Panel-dev/1Panel/pull/14407 * MCP Management: Fixed installation failures caused by a nonexistent default image version by @lan-yonghui in https://github.com/1Panel-dev/1Panel/pull/14411、https://github.com/1Panel-dev/1Panel/pull/14416 * Multi-Node: Fixed prerelease version handling during node upgrades by @ssongliu

新增功能

* 【模型】支持接入外部 vLLM 实例并纳入概览监控 by @ssongliu in https://github.com/1Panel-dev/1Panel/pull/14402 ### 功能优化 * 【模型】优化 GPU 分组卡片布局并按拓扑排序 by @ssongliu in https://github.com/1Panel-dev/1Panel/pull/14404 * 【模型】优化 vLLM 部署列表展示并默认关闭镜像拉取选项 by @ssongliu ### 问题修复 * 【模型】修复了 vLLM 自定义镜像同步及版本切换时默认镜像重置异常的问题 by @ssongliu in https://github.com/1Panel-dev/1Panel/pull/14406 * 【模型】修复了 GB10 双节点 vLLM 部署与升级时版本匹配异常的问题 by @ssongliu in https://github.com/1Panel-dev/1Panel/pull/14407 * 【MCP 管理】修复了默认镜像版本不存在导致安装失败的问题 by @lan-yonghui in https://github.com/1Panel-dev/1Panel/pull/14411、https://github.com/1Panel-dev/1Panel/pull/14416 * 【多机管理】修复了节点升级时预发布版本识别异常的问题 by @ssongliu
